name: mindmap.io
summary: AI-era mind maps where every node can be a chat, with Promptmaps across frontier models and use from Claude, ChatGPT or Grok.
description: AI-era mind maps where every node can be a chat, with Promptmaps across frontier models and use from Claude, ChatGPT or Grok.

pricing.details: Free (3 generations a day on limited models). Mindmaps 6 €/month billed annually (unlimited maps, more daily AI). Promptmaps 26 €/month billed annually (all frontier models, 10× more AI; 9 €/month of AI included, as stated). A Lifetime plan is also sold in limited official batches (list 240 €; a 88 € then 151 € batch offer was shown on 11 November 2026).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Keyboard-first mind maps where every node can be a chat
Use from Claude, ChatGPT or Grok
Lifetime sold in limited official batches
